nodes.translate: Hello! What would you like?
nodes.why: 新华书店: 故事书 15 元 · 毛笔 20 元 · 书法 50 元. Say what you want and how many — 「两个包子」, 「一瓶水」 — ask 「多少钱？」 any time, and say 「不要了」 when that is all.

nodes.translate: Hello! What would you like?
nodes.why: 月饼: 月饼 8 元. Say what you want and how many — 「两个包子」, 「一瓶水」 — ask 「多少钱？」 any time, and say 「不要了」 when that is all.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: Wangfujing is a sea of people today!
nodes.why: A 成语 📌: 人山人海 — mountains of people, seas of people. You can guess it from its four characters.

nodes.translate: Hello! What can I do for you?

nodes.say: 换钱？好的。请给我你的护照。
nodes.translate: Change money? Certainly. Your passport, please.
How many dollars have you got?
nodes.why: Only a hundred to change today.

nodes.say: 一百美元，七百块钱。请在这儿签字。
nodes.translate: A hundred dollars — seven hundred yuan. Please sign here.

nodes.say: 好了。这是你的钱和护照。
nodes.translate: Done. Here's your money and your passport — and your 美元 receipt.

words.explain: 用一个国家的钱，换别的国家的钱。
去别的国家用的小本子。

nodes.translate: Hello! One moment, please.
Hello! What book are you looking for?

nodes.say: 成语的书？这本很好。三十块。
nodes.translate: A book of idioms? This one is very good. Thirty yuan.
Here you are! Have a look.
nodes.why: 《成语故事》 — your 成语 book. Every 成语 you have heard is written in it now (🎒 → 成语).

nodes.translate: All right, have another look around.

words.explain: 四个字的老话，每个都有一个故事。

nodes.translate: Hello! What would you like?
Red paper? Five yuan. Here you are.
Hello! Have a look around.
Hello! What's the matter?
nodes.why: Say who is ill and how: 感冒 a cold, 发烧 a fever.

nodes.translate: A cold? Any fever?

nodes.say: 这个药很好。一天三次，饭后吃。二十块。
nodes.translate: This medicine is good. Three times a day, after meals. Twenty yuan.

nodes.say: 一天三次，饭后吃！多喝水。
nodes.translate: Three times a day, after meals! And drink lots of water.
nodes.why: 一天三次 — three times a day; 饭后 — after meals. Pharmacists always say it twice.

words.explain: 身体不好的时候吃的东西。

nodes.translate: Hello! Drink lots of water!

nodes.say: 今天人很多！书店在那儿。
nodes.translate: So many people today! The bookshop's over there.

hint.frame: 我想买一个东西，___给王阿姨。
hint.full: 我想买一个东西，送给王阿姨。

nodes.translate: Hello! What would you like?
nodes.why: 送给 — to give (as a present) to.

nodes.say: 给阿姨的？她喜欢什么颜色？
nodes.translate: For an auntie? What colour does she like?

nodes.say: 红色的围巾很好看，五十块。你要吗？
nodes.translate: A red scarf is lovely — fifty yuan. Would you like it?
nodes.why: 围巾 — a scarf. The measure word for long things is 条: 一条围巾.

nodes.say: 好！围巾给你。阿姨会很高兴！
nodes.translate: Here you are — your scarf. She'll be very happy!

words.explain: 天冷的时候，放在脖子上的长东西。

nodes.translate: Hello! What's the matter?

nodes.say: 你的朋友怎么了？发烧吗？咳嗽吗？
nodes.translate: What's wrong with your friend? A fever? A cough?
nodes.why: A key line 📌: 发烧 a fever, 咳嗽 a cough. The two words you most need at a Chinese pharmacy.

nodes.say: 发烧，咳嗽……他要多喝热水，多休息！
nodes.translate: A fever, a cough… he should drink lots of hot water and rest!
nodes.why: 多喝热水 — “drink more hot water” — is what every Chinese doctor, mother and friend says.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: Hot water? I'm made of clay!
nodes.translate: 兔儿爷, sniffing.
Hello! What would you like?

nodes.say: 红纸？五块。你要画门神吗？
nodes.translate: Red paper? Five yuan. Are you going to paint door gods?

nodes.say: 门神有两个，要画对！这本书给你看看。
nodes.translate: There are two door gods — paint them right! Have a look at this book.
nodes.why: She gives you 《门神》. Page 6: how must the two stand?

hint.frame: 我想买一个东西，___给王阿姨。
hint.full: 我想买一个东西，送给王阿姨。

nodes.translate: Hello! What would you like?

nodes.say: 给阿姨的？她喜欢红色吗？
nodes.translate: For an auntie? Does she like red?

nodes.say: 没关系！今天有小围巾，不要钱。这个小围巾给你！
nodes.translate: Never mind! Today there are little scarves for free. This little scarf is yours!
nodes.why: 送 — here, a free gift from the shop.

words.explain: 天冷的时候，放在脖子上的长东西。

steps.now: 兔儿爷: spirits like old books. Ride to 王府井 — line 8 south from 南锣鼓巷.
steps.past: Rode to 王府井, the big shopping street.

steps.now: Your money is nearly gone. Change money at the bank 银行 on 王府井 — you have your passport.
steps.past: Changed money at the bank on 王府井.

steps.now: A present for 王阿姨, who has been so kind: the department store 百货大楼 on 王府井 has scarves. Tell the shop assistant who it's for and what colour she likes.
steps.past: Bought a red scarf for 王阿姨 at 百货大楼.

steps.now: Find a book of 成语 at the bookshop 新华书店, north on 王府井 — 兔儿爷 wants to write down the ones you've heard.
steps.past: Found a book of 成语 at 新华书店 — now they have a home.

steps.now: 兔儿爷 is sneezing — he caught a cold in the wind on 景山! Tell the doctor at the pharmacy 药店 what's wrong with him: 发烧, 咳嗽.
steps.past: Told the pharmacist 兔儿爷 had a fever and a cough. “多喝热水！”

steps.now: The book talks of 门神, the door gods. Ride one stop south to 前门 and ask at the opera house 戏园.
steps.past: Asked at the opera house in 前门 about the door gods.

steps.now: The owner of the opera house 戏园 has an invitation for you.
steps.past: The opera house owner invited me to tonight's show and gave me 《脸谱》.

steps.now: “Wear something nice to the opera.” The silk shop 瑞蚨祥 in 大栅栏 lends clothes — tell the woman there where you're going.
steps.past: 瑞蚨祥 lent me a Chinese jacket for the opera.

steps.now: Go back to the opera house for the show. The owner will ask you something from 《脸谱》 (page 3).
steps.past: Watched 京剧 at 前门 — 关羽, the red face.

steps.now: The door gods need red paper to be painted again. The bookshop on 王府井 sells 红纸.
steps.past: Bought red paper at the bookshop for the door gods.

steps.now: Take the red paper to the old gate at the south end of 前门大街. The door gods will ask how they should stand — 《门神》 page 6.
steps.past: Brought red paper to the old gate in 大栅栏 — the door gods woke up.

steps.now: Take 王阿姨 her present and tell her about the door gods.
steps.past: Gave 王阿姨 her red scarf and told her about the door gods.

quests.title: 王阿姨 has a cold
quests.blurb: 王阿姨 has a cold and a fever, and she looks after everyone but herself.
quests.lead: 王阿姨 is coughing in the courtyard.

steps.now: 王阿姨 has a cold and a little fever. Buy cold medicine at the pharmacy 药店 on 王府井 — say what's wrong.
steps.past: Bought cold medicine at the 药店 on 王府井.

steps.now: Take the medicine back to 王阿姨 in the courtyard.

quests.title: A book for 小明
quests.blurb: 小明 has read all his books twice and wants a new storybook.
quests.lead: 小明 says he has nothing new to read.

steps.now: 小明 wants a storybook 故事书. The bookshop on 王府井 has them.
steps.past: Bought a storybook at the 王府井 bookshop.

steps.now: Give 小明 the storybook — he plays on 南锣鼓巷.

idioms.meaning: huge crowds; a sea of people

story.zh: 人多得像山，多得像海。王府井和天安门，过年过节的时候，都是人山人海。
story.en: People as many as a mountain, as many as the sea — Wangfujing and Tiananmen on a holiday.

items.name: 围巾
items.en: a red scarf — a present for 王阿姨

steps.en: 王府井 — shops as old as the city, and a bookshop. Spirits love old books. Achoo… that 景山 wind.
